name: Collaborative Playlists
description: Manage per-user editor access for Jellyfin playlists.
overview: Adds native per-user playlist editor controls to the Jellyfin Web Edit Playlist dialog.

versions.changelog:
- Include hidden Jellyfin accounts in the editor picker while excluding disabled users.
- Add owner-only editor management to the standard Jellyfin Web Edit Playlist dialog.
- Use Jellyfin's native playlist sharing and CanEdit permissions.
